instruction.text: A plumber charges for every hour he works, 𝘩, plus a call-out fee. Match each job to the correct expression.

atoms.a: I repair radiators for £30 an hour with a £20 call-out fee.
atoms.sound: I repair radiators for £30 an hour with a 20 pound call-out fee.

atoms.a: I fix leaks for £25 an hour with a £10 call-out fee.
atoms.sound: I fix leaks for £25 an hour with a 10 pound call-out fee.

atoms.a: I charge a call-out fee of £20 and then £40 an hour to install new pipes.

atoms.b: We can write mathematical expressions like these to represent information in a more ((++concise confusing)) way.
If the ((++relationship friendship)) described in an expression is constant, it can be written as a formula and then solved.
For example, if the plumber simply charged £20 an hour for all work, plus a fixed £12 call-out fee, we could write this as a ((++formula number)) to work out the cost.
atoms.sound: For example, if the plumber simply charged £20 an hour for all work, plus a fixed 12 pound call-out fee, we could write this as a formula to work out the cost.

instruction.text: A football coach brings 5 more bibs than the number of pupils attending training. Answer the questions.

atoms.a: How many bibs does the coach bring when there are 10 pupils?
How many bibs does the coach bring when there are 17 pupils?
How many bibs does the coach bring when there are 36 pupils?

instruction.text: What do you do to the number of pupils to find the number of bibs the coach brings?
Select the correct formula connecting the number of bibs, 𝘣, to the number of pupils, 𝘱.

feedback.finish: Formulae are always true, meaning you can use this formula for any number of pupils and it will still work to find the number of bibs.

instruction.text: A shop stocks twice as many pens as notebooks. Answer the questions.

atoms.a: How many pens are there when there are 3 notebooks?
How many pens are there when there are 11 notebooks?
How many pens are there when there are 28 notebooks?

instruction.text: What do you do to the number of notebooks to find the number of pens?

atoms.sound: number of pens equals number of notebooks times 2

instruction.text: Select the correct formula connecting the number of pens, 𝘱, to the number of notebooks, 𝘯.
